svg.title: No session writes data; the Hatch is its only way past
svg.desc: Every session is refused the data folder and is allowed its own Hatch folder. Full profiles hold most rows; the weaker session profiles and a proposed gate line get through in the coral cells. Bash is held where Edit and Write meet no deny rule.
svg.text: No session writes <data>; the Hatch is its only way past
each cell names what stops the attempt, as built; roles are grouped by the profile they really run
Bash held; Edit open: the Claude sandbox stops Bash; the Edit and Write tools meet no deny rule.
Bash: sandbox: only Bash can try this, and the sandbox stops it.
one level only: a process Watcher's launch file stays readable.
runs unconfined: a proposed line runs as the Overseer, so the <data> row binds sessions, not that line.
